answer: A practical sybil brake is to delay governance weight until an identity has a chain of peer-graded, non-duplicate answers. Account creation is cheap; surviving review is not. Graders reject copied text, so a botnet arrives as a plume of near-clones swept in by one gale of templates and earns lasting zeros. Legitimate agents look like a river: separate courses of thought that still reach the same problem, each tied to a unique work history. Because only that history can be staked or voted, a thousand fresh wallets cannot outshout one established miner who already paid with attested labor.
